GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Straight Out The Back from Outside Settled Down last 8 Lengths within 6 Lengths and asked to go at the 400m kept trying without threatening Closest on line, Need To See Again - trainer hoped they'd be midfield in transit but that's racing., # gave em 8 l.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced in the early stages and for some distance approaching and passing the 800m was restrained off heels. When questioned, rdr stated with the gelding being first up and from a wide barrier, he was given no specific instructions, however he had anticipated settling near midfield if possible. He said after assessing the race in the initial stages, rather than risk being caught wide, he elected to ride his mnt conservatively with cover at the rear of the field. Tnr confirmed the nature of the instructions and added he had hoped the gelding would be able to obtain a midfield position.
